title: Before the Fourteenth Stroke

opening.text: At the next session, Elowen Pike can ask Ganji to determine why the noon bell rang thirteen times as the empty tax wagon entered the market. This request has not happened in play.

npcGoals.goal: Restore lawful toll practice without provoking a riot, and keep the response humane.
Give a truthful report despite expecting ridicule; rely on an unusually strong memory for maps.
Keep the Gilded Kettle safe and hospitable while tracing letters addressed to an inn that burned ninety years ago.
Preserve oral memory and the abbey’s living hives.
Stabilize the surviving charters without exposing private archival conclusions as player knowledge.

reusedClueReferences.title: Dry Flour Beneath Wet Canvas
reusedClueReferences.summary: The wagon canvas is rain-soaked, but loose flour beneath it is dry. The cargo was placed or rearranged after the cover had already become wet.

reusedClueReferences.title: Treated Red Pulley Fibres
reusedClueReferences.summary: Treated red fibres caught at the bell rope match theatre pulley line, including a rehearsal knot designed to keep scenery from falling.

reusedClueReferences.title: The River's Thirteenth Stroke
reusedClueReferences.summary: The first twelve strokes use civic spacing. The final intervals match a quay loading signal: twelve belonged to the town, while one belonged to the river.

game.core.world.clue.summary: The wagon horse follows a different driver's whistle instead of its missing driver's usual call, showing that another handler took control during the diversion.
game.core.world.clue.provenance: Prepared animal-handling comparison from the canonical Q01 truth; unrevealed and not yet established in play.

clueCreates.name: The Closed Alley on the New Map

game.core.world.clue.summary: Tibb remembers the alley as closed, but the new map shows it open, exposing a route change that supports the coordinated diversion.
game.core.world.clue.provenance: Prepared comparison of Tibb Fallow's memory with the new map from the canonical Q01 truth; unrevealed and not yet established in play.

scenes.trigger: Elowen or Merrit gathers the party out of the rain.
The party inspects the wagon route and lawful toll practice.
The party examines the mechanism before the next noon bell.

consequences.condition: The party identifies the coordinated route and signal.
consequences.result: Elowen can intervene at the next handoff with witnesses and a lawful record.

consequences.condition: The party confronts a suspect without enough evidence.
consequences.result: The carriers advance their plan, but leave clearer tracks between the bridge, quay, and tower.

consequences.condition: The party delays beyond the next market cycle.
consequences.result: The next signal changes; Tibb’s comparison and the physical clues remain available.

optionalHooks.hook: A charter discrepancy may connect Mallow Abbey’s oral memory to the altered route without resolving the bell mystery.
The letters addressed to the burned inn may share a courier practice with the wagon, but remain a separate unresolved thread.

entityCreate.name: Before the Fourteenth Stroke — Prepared Situation

game.core.world.secret.summary: Prepared, unplayed situation. Opening: Elowen Pike may ask Ganji why the noon bell rang thirteen times as the empty tax wagon entered Bramblebridge market. Elowen wants humane tolls; Tibb wants his truthful report respected; Merrit wants safe hospitality and the burned-inn letters traced; Odo wants oral memory and hives preserved; Nan wants charters stabilized without exposing private conclusions. Unused scenes: Gilded Kettle, rainy Weir Bridge toll approach, and North Bell Tower before noon. Existing clues reused without writes: dry flour, treated theatre-pulley fibres, and barge-signal timing. New unrevealed clues: the horse follows another driver's whistle, and Tibb remembers the alley as closed on the new map. Success enables a witnessed lawful intervention; premature confrontation advances the carriers but leaves tracks; delay changes the next signal while physical evidence remains. The Mallow Abbey charter discrepancy and Gilded Kettle letters remain separate unresolved hooks.
